# MassLive.com

> MassLive.com is a local marketplace and classifieds platform serving Massachusetts with listings across multiple categories including pets, jobs, vehicles, real estate, and business services.

MassLive.com operates a comprehensive classifieds marketplace that connects buyers and sellers across the Massachusetts region. The platform aggregates listings for various categories to facilitate local commerce and community engagement.

- local marketplace
- pets
